title: Fluidd "Upload & Print": guard that keeps the fix in place (runs at boot and nightly)
note: Fluidd's Upload & Print button uploaded the file but did not start the print. At boot and nightly this guard looks in the active Fluidd bundle for that broken code itself (no checksums): repaired code present = nothing to do; the known broken code found once = repaired, only while the printer is idle; anything else = nothing changed. It never starts a print.
